headline: Revenue steady but profit and margins fall back
summary_short: Revenue was INR 18,770M (+1.6% q/q) but net income fell 36.5% q/q to INR 1,557M, with EPS of INR 52.89 down 9.6% y/y.
summary_long: Gross profit fell 16.1% q/q to INR 7,557M on flat revenue, so gross margin narrowed to about 40.3% from 48.8%. EBITDA dropped 30.9% to INR 2,965M and operating income to INR 1,685M from INR 3,155M. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures are Yahoo fundamentals-timeseries and earningsChart data.
